title: The Alibi of Ashcombe
author: Sebastian Okonkwo
blurb: Ivo Kavanagh, an estate lawyer reading a will that shouldn't exist, thought they had seen every way a life can end. Then the missing person's diary continues past the date she disappeared — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
